rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose casual way to describe something that takes a long time or has a lot of content.

example.english: This series is lengthy; I watched it all evening and still did not finish it.
example.traditional: 呢套劇好長，我睇咗成晚都未睇完。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 kek6 hou2 coeng4 ngo5 tai2 zo2 seng4 maan5 dou1 mei6 tai2 jyun4

rows.note: Choose this for a text, speech, or explanation that is long-winded or unnecessarily extended.

example.english: This report is too lengthy, so the main points are obscured.
example.traditional: 呢份報告寫得太冗長，重點反而唔突出。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 taai3 jung2 coeng4 zung6 dim2 faan2 ji4 m4 dat6 ceot1

rows.note: Use this mainly for a period, wait, or process that seems to last an unusually long time.

example.english: The approval process is quite lengthy.
example.traditional: 等候審批嘅過程相當漫長。
example.jyutping: dang2 hau6 sam2 pai1 ge3 gwo3 cing4 soeng1 dong1 maan6 coeng4
